title: Biya Ali Asgharam
body:
Ali asghar...
Dasht e purhaal mein matam ki sadaa goonj uthi..(2)
Karbala roti hai, hawa roti hai, alqama roti hai
Barsare, barsare karbobala girya kuna madaram
biya ali asgharam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Tu gaya saath tere ghar ke ujale bhi gaye
sar se waali bhi gaya god ke paale bhi gaye..(2)
haath hai,
haath hai dil pe buka lab pe kahe chashme namm
biya ali asgharam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Khali jhule ki taraf dekh ke karti hu buka
jhulne wala nahi kisko jhulau jhula..(2)
ek maa,
ek maa hi nahi jhula bhi kahe ye baham
biya ali asgharam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Jaane wale tere jaane se teri maa ujdi
teri hamsheer tere baad meri jaa'n ujdi..(2)
roke wo,
roke wo karti hai fariyad labo par hai damm
biya ali asgharam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Bayn karti hai sakina mai karu kya jeekar
tu mere paas hai ammu hai na bhayya akbar..(2)
pyaas se,
pyaas se din bhi mere jeene ke ab to hai kam
biya ali asgharam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Dard ye jeene nahi dega teri madar ko
jo laga tujhko tere qad se bada teer tha wo..(2)
aur isi,
aur isi ghum mein dilafgaar hai ehle haram
biya ali asgharam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Tu bata ghum ko tere dil se bhulaye kaise
dhoop mein tu hai to maa saaye mein jaaye kaise..(2)
saaye mein,
saaye mein jaane nahi deta mujhe tera ghum
biya ali asgharam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Tu nahi aaya to mai jaa'n se guzar jaungi
saans bhi chalti rahe laash bhi kehlaungi..(2)
zindagi,
zindagi tu hai meri tere lahu ki qasam
biya ali asgharam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Tere hi dum se to roshan thi hamari duniya
nauha  karte hai haram nanhe mujahid aaja..(2)
laut aa,
laut aa, aa nahi sakte hai tere paas hum
biya ali asgharam..(4)
<<DIVIDER>>
9. Ye wo alfaaz hai khud jis pe qaza rone lage
Bayn mazhar ne likhe ehle azaa rone lage..(2)
ek hi,
ek hi lafz bana jaata hai irfan e ghum
biya ali asgharam..(4)
